  SPECIAL MEETING

  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  26-54536  Recommendation to approve minutes for the Housing Authority of the City of Long
  Beach, California meeting of Tuesday, February 10, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  26-54537  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing the Long Beach Housing
  Authority, or designee, to execute a contract, and any necessary documents
  including any necessary subsequent amendments, with Paul Edwards
  Management and Consulting, of Vallejo, CA, to provide remote recertification
  services for the Housing Authority, in a total amount not to exceed $294,727, for a
  period of one year ending December 31, 2026, at the discretion of the Housing
  Authority Director. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT
